items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he played with a guy...I think it was Chester Clark's band.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played with a guy...I think it was Chester Clark's band. That's the band that Sweets was playing with. This is before Sweets ever went to Kansas City and joined the Jeter-Pillars band. You might have heard of that.
